per_object_cap.stated: unverified: a third party reports 4 GB per file on the free plan but now states the figure is not confirmed against official guidance; maxFileBytes is returned per account and depends on the plan

retention.stated: unverified: a third party previously reported dormancy after two years without a login, but now states no MYBOX-specific dormancy deletion rule was found in official documents and that the general Naver account policy appears to apply

egress.terms: No egress fee documented. The binding limit is the API's 50,000 downloads a day, flat across all plan tiers from 30 GB to 20 TB; the page states the plan tiers share one limit only until 2026-12-31 and limits may differ by plan after that date

tooling: an official MYBOX Open API with personal access tokens against https://open-api.mybox.naver.com/v1, bearer mbx_pat_ tokens with a 30, 60, 90 or 180-day lifetime and at most five per account. No rclone backend
chaining: 30 GB times N Naver IDs, where each needs a real-name-verifiable Naver account. 30 GB is 6% of the 500 GB floor, so it only helps if Naver ID creation is already solved

limits.value: unverified: a third party reports 4 GB per file on the free plan but now states the figure is not confirmed against official guidance
50,000 API downloads a day, 30 searches a minute and 240 deletes a minute
unverified: a third party previously reported dormancy after two years without a login, but now states no MYBOX-specific dormancy deletion rule was found in official documents

identity_cost.detail: If you are using a mobile phone, you can verify your identity when signing up even if the mobile phone is not subscribed under your name, but you cannot sign up by any means other than your mobile phone.

reliability_note: An explicit excess-use clause: bulk calls or excess use get access restricted without notice, and dormant accounts and their tokens fail. The market consolidated and MYBOX is the only Korean free personal drive left

binding_note: Storage is limited to 30 GB total on the first-party page. The 4 GB per-file cap and the dormancy deletion rule are unverified: the third party that supplied them now says official guidance does not confirm either.
notes: The cleanest documented API in the Asian drive set and the smallest quota. Recorded because an official API with personal access tokens is rare in this population, and because two years of dormancy deleting the bytes is a retention fact that a reader would not guess.
